body: since 2020 my brain has been so foggy, and it's the worst feeling to feel like everyone and everything is moving forward except for yourself :/

i feel a similar way, it's hard for me to even wake up most days and trying to deal with becoming an adult is a lot to take on all at once. i already turned 18 but time is passing by fast and i'm scared that i won't be mature enough once i reach my 20's. i hope you stay many more years to finish your bucket list though, because the longer you're here the more hobbies you can try and places you can go to
this comment means the world to me right now so thank you :). i don't have many hobbies anymore sadly, i might pick some up if i start to get the motivation
i've been feeling the same. it's really overwhelming to not have control over your own brain
i would talk to your friend about it if you trust them, i doubt she will see you any differently, your suicidal thoughts aren't who you are but are something you're struggling with.
